warmup.description: Quickly elevate heart rate and prepare for short, intense intervals.

main_exercises.name: Sprint Intervals: 20s max effort / 40s walk or rest
main_exercises.load_guidance: Max effort sprint or fast run; aim for 9-10/10 intensity during work phase
main_exercises.form_cue: Drive arms and knees powerfully while keeping posture tall.

main_exercises.name: Bodyweight Complex (AMRAP x 10 minutes)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight; pace to sustain high effort without full burnout
main_exercises.form_cue: Move continuously with controlled breathing and efficient transitions.

main_exercises.name: Explosive Core Finisher: 30s on / 15s off
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight; aim for fast, sharp reps while maintaining control
main_exercises.form_cue: Stay tight through the core and avoid excessive momentum.

cooldown.description: Bring heart rate down and release tension after intense intervals.
movements: Standing quad stretch x 45s per side

phase_notes.menstrual: This high-impact, sprint-based session is not recommended during this phase. Opt for lower intensity or reduce volume significantly if needed.
phase_notes.follicular: Energy is rising—push hard on sprint intervals and aim to maintain a strong pace during the AMRAP without long breaks.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Ideal phase for max output—go all-in on sprints and explosive movements while staying technically sharp.
phase_notes.early_luteal: You can still perform strongly, but focus on pacing during the AMRAP to avoid early fatigue from the sprints.
phase_notes.late_luteal: High intensity may feel overwhelming—consider reducing sprint rounds or swapping jumps for lower impact alternatives.
